purpose: Build and measure only tilings produced by an operator's own original source. This lock is intentionally not a performance model or a tiling database.

invariants.candidate_identity: source route + tiling key + exact raw tiling bytes + block dimension + workspace
invariants.deduplicate: only exact candidate_identity duplicates may be removed
invariants.acceptance: each candidate must pass original-reference output comparison before latency is recorded

official_source.selected_because: latest public commit dated before the installed CANN 8.1.RC1 build timestamp

mat_mul_v3.all_route_semantics: first successful original heuristic only; it is not a candidate enumerator
mat_mul_v3.multi_tiling_method: invoke each existing non-ALL route in an independent original tiling context; keep only distinct successful raw tilings
forbidden: changing any MatmulTilingData field after original tiling
synthesizing a tile from a cost model
calling RuntimeKb or a callback to select a candidate

scatter_elements_v2.multi_tiling_method: only modes or schedules already selected by its original source; no field-level edits

gather_elements_v2.multi_tiling_method: only source-exposed original modes; reject if no distinct source tilings exist

flash_attention_score_grad.multi_tiling_method: only source-exposed original modes; reject if no distinct source tilings exist

fused_infer_attention_score.multi_tiling_method: only source-exposed original modes; reject if no distinct source tilings exist

transpose.reason: the extracted tree contains arch35 tiling code but no matching 910B/arch32 tiling implementation; changing a header or CMake label would not make that source valid

gather_v2.reason: the extracted source explicitly treats Ascend910B as unsupported for this route; do not fake support by changing headers
